isolationHint.worktree: Each agent works on its own git copy of the working folder, so nobody overwrites anyone else. Best for teams writing code.

agents.resetPolicyHint: Before a new session starts, the agent writes a handoff note that the next session reads. A session idle for over an hour is also renewed, since its cache has expired.
agents.allowedCommandsHint: One per line. Claude runs each with any arguments, without asking. Other commands that change something are denied, since a headless turn cannot ask you. Scripts you allow can do anything, so list only what the agent needs.
agents.leanModeHint: Run Claude without your user-level plugins, skills, hooks and MCP servers, with only the file and shell tools. If the agent needs an MCP server (for example Jira), pick it below.
agents.leanMcpServers: MCP servers kept in lean mode
agents.noMcpServers: No MCP servers found in your Claude Code config or plugins.
agents.mcpServersHint: Leave empty to load every Claude Code MCP server. Pick servers to load only those (claude.ai connectors are dropped too).
agents.codexMcpServersHint: Leave empty to load every Codex MCP server. Pick servers to switch the others in config.toml off for the agent's turns; servers added by Codex plugins stay on.
agents.fallbackEngine: Fallback engine when out of quota
agents.fallbackEngineHint: When the main engine runs out of quota, its messages are held and run again at the reset. With a fallback, the agent switches to it right away, carrying its handoff note, and returns to the main engine once that works again.
agents.addMcpServerDescription: The hub runs the picked CLI's mcp add to put the server in its user-level config. The hub keeps no copy of the config or its tokens. Every agent on that CLI, and your own runs of it, will see the server.
agents.mcpLoginHint: If the server needs an OAuth sign-in, sign in after adding it. Codex: run codex mcp login {{name}}. Claude Code: open claude and type /mcp.
agents.mcpEnvHint: Arguments: one per line. Environment variables: one KEY=value per line. Tokens here only pass through the mcp add command line; the hub does not store or log them. Values with shell characters (" % ^ & | < > ! $) need adding with the CLI in a terminal.

leanMode.title: Lean mode
leanMode.body: Runs Claude without your user-level plugins, skills and MCP servers. Each model call then carries about 10k baseline tokens instead of 49k. Pick any MCP server it needs below.

fallbackEngine.title: Fallback engine
fallbackEngine.body: When the main engine runs out of quota, the agent switches to this one right away, with its handoff note, instead of waiting for the reset.

terminal.title: See what the agent is doing
terminal.body: The terminal shows each command, file and tool the agent uses in the running turn. A Claude agent reads what you send mid-turn in that same turn, so steer it as soon as it drifts.

taskChanges.title: Task code
taskChanges.body: The hub never merges. Review the diff here, and run this git merge in your repo when it looks right.

tips.leanMode: Turn on lean mode to cut the baseline per model call from about 49k tokens to 10k.
tips.fallbackEngine: Pick a fallback engine so the agent keeps working when it runs out of quota.
tips.allowedCommands: Allow commands such as npm test so the agent can run tests itself. Headless turns cannot ask you, so commands not allowed are refused.
